title: In-house 360-degree product photography
description: 360° photo studios with turntables and integrated LED lighting: specialized solutions for jewelry, mannequins and PackshotCreator automation software.
content:
We develop turntables and professional 360° photo studios with consistent lighting and powerful software, dedicated to creating 360° product animations in-house. Our solutions make it possible to create a smooth production workflow from shooting, through cutout and editing, to the assembly of the animation. The entire photographic process is automated, which makes it possible to easily and quickly create 360° product visuals for ecommerce, social networks or product archiving.

Fully automated photo studios for 360° shooting

Our best-sellers, the fully automated photo studios, consist of a patented backlit turntable and advanced LED lighting to easily create 360° product views on a white background, pure or transparent.

Make your products interactive

Increase conversions on your website by creating interactive animations. Our powerful and easy-to-use software allows any member of your company to create 360-degree animations in just a few seconds with complete control over all the features of the animation: speed, rotation, the style and colors of the buttons, and many other parameters. For example, add a zoom to display your product more dynamically, without customers missing a single detail.

360 photo studios with integrated and backlit turntables

These photo studios offer complete control over the lighting, a backlit turntable and unique software that automates all photo production workflows. The system and the software work in perfect synchronization to deliver the best results in the shortest time. In addition to creating photos and videos, our photographic studios and equipment allow you to produce, in just a few seconds, 360° animations on white or transparent backgrounds. They have been specially designed to meet the needs of all business sectors and to accommodate products of small and large sizes, and even mannequins and live models.

360° photography of jewelry and precious stones

PackshotCreator offers a complete range of turntables and 360° photo studios specially designed for jewelry and precious stones. They feature integrated and backlit turntables to photograph and animate your rings, earrings, bracelets, watches, precious stones, diamonds, and even necklaces and pendants in suspended mode.With its various 360° shooting and display options, PackshotCreator gives you the ability to showcase your jewelry in the best possible way.

Turntables for 360° photography

We design custom professional turntables for 360° product photography, for each use and each product size. The PackshotCreator software fully controls the camera and the rotation of the turntable, thus automating the entire 360° creation process. From positioning the product, automating capture, to batch editing and export, every setting in the software can be saved and reused over time to increase productivity.

360° photo studios for mannequins and models

The PackshotAlto Mark II (L and XL) are photo studios made up of professional and sophisticated lighting and an integrated turntable. They allow you to save time and space when photographing models and mannequins.

Experience in 360° product photography

Founded in 2001, Sysnext now offers turntables and 360° photography studios under its PackshotCreator commercial brand, launched in 2004. More and more companies are continuously adopting better approaches to communicate the value and details of their products. PackshotCreator has therefore supported this movement and these companies in creating their product visuals over the years.

Why use the 360 feature for an ecommerce website?

  • Increase conversion rates
  • Provide more information and details since hotspots, annotations, links and other relevant information can be added to the animations
  • Maintain the interest of potential customers and make them stay longer on a website
  • Strengthen consumer confidence. It is important to be able to see a product from every angle before making a purchase
  • Reduce product returns
  • Make online shopping a more fun experience since potential customers can interact with the 360° animations

The PackshotCreator advantages

Capture speed and productivity

Our turntables and our 360° product photography studios are part of an important workflow. The powerful software controls every photographic element and the process to streamline the completion of all the work. In addition, the best settings can be reused to make productivity easier and faster.Our workflows have been specially designed for permanent operating procedures while retaining the ability to be creative.

Built to last

PackshotCreator products are fully field-tested.

  • Compact and flexible
  • Perfectly smooth 360° rotation
  • Product positioning and centering
  • High-precision rotation
  • High capture speed

Cutting-edge technology

The patented and refined 360 turntables allow users to:

  • Control and adjust the LED intensity of the backlighting
  • Easily photograph and create 360° product views on white and transparent backgrounds
  • Change the speed of the turntables

Other possibilities

Buy a system and get more than 360° animations. Create everything you need: professional photos, 360° animations and videos, multi-angle views, animated GIFs and much more. Export the same visual in different formats simultaneously.

Available formats:

  • JPG, TIFF, RAW, PNG
  • HTML5, GIF
  • MOV, MP4

Your 360° products, everywhere

Our HTML5 product animations can be displayed online on all platforms and all browsers. They can also be easily shared and viewed offline.

  • Fully responsive
  • Smartphone-compatible
  • Custom plugins and a 360-degree user guide are offered free of charge to PackshotCreator customers

"Custom Defined" feature

Photograph your products from different angles without handling the product. The "Custom Defined" feature of the PackshotCreator software allows you to define in advance the desired shooting angles. Use a camera and simply choose the different angles, then click "snap" and the software does all the rest. Create a custom shooting profile and reuse it to automate and speed up the workflow.

Captivating viewpoints on products

Make your website more attractive with high-quality and consistent photos, and interactive 360° animations. Give your customers a hands-on experience with your products by creating HTML5 profiles. This format allows users to fully customize their animations: setting their rotation parameters and speed, adding a deep zoom and interactive buttons such as play/pause, full screen, social networks and others.In addition to being fully customized, your 360° product animations will be compatible on all platforms and visible without any additional plug-in!
